Name: Boho Bed Collection
Author: inmognito
Description:
A collection of hippy/boho style beds for Alternative textures.

[b]Installation
[/b][list=1]
[*]Unzip the file
[*]Paste into the Mods folder
[*]After the first house upgrade you will receive a bed in the mail which you can then place in your farmhouse and use the Paint Bucket to give it the skin you want.

[/list][size=5][b]IMPORTANT: If you want to remove the mod, delete the bed first!
[/b][/size]

[b]Compatibility
[/b]
The boho beds are larger than standard beds so ﻿
[list]
[*]Other AT bed textures may look a bit weird if applied to the bed you receive in the mail or the 'double bed' from the furniture catalog
[*]If boho bed textures are applied to standard size beds the bottom will end up being cut off.
[*]Strange things happen if used with [b]Free Love[/b]/[b]Multiple Spouses[/b].
[*]Otherwise it should all work.
[/list]
